title: introduce-ci-policy-templates-and-opa-gate-for-dependency-updates
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: We're seeing duplicated workflow logic across repos and inconsistent behavior for dependency bumps and license checks. This PR introduces a set of reusable CI workflow templates plus a lightweight policy-as-code gate using OPA to (a) enforce allowed dependency upgrades, (b) validate license/CLA metadata on dependency manifests, and (c) ensure lint/test matrices match supported runtimes. The goal is to reduce per-repo CI drift, centralize dependency policy, and make release automation safer via a post-merge canary run. What changed: - Added .github/workflow-templates/ci-template.yaml and release-template.yaml (reusable templates for presubmit/build/test and post-merge release checks). - Added .github/actions/opa-policy-check/ (composite action) which runs an opa eval against a bundled rego policy set and a small python helper to extract dependency candidates from package.json/Pipfile/requirements.txt. The action returns a non-zero exit and a structured message when policy violations are found. - Introduced policy rules: disallow deps with unknown licenses, prevent minor/major bumps for pinned security flagged packages without manual approval, and require dependency bump Linear reference in PR body. - Updated repo-specific workflows to use templates (redwood monorepo: .github/workflows/ci.yaml now instantiates ci-template and passes matrix parameters). - Simplified the test matrix: removed legacy Node 12/14 jobs, standardized to node 16/18 and python 3.9/3.11 where applicable. - Added a new release-phase job "post-merge-canary" to the release template that performs a smoke-run against staging endpoints with canary model routing enabled; failures trigger automatic rollback steps documented in the template. - Minor hygiene: CODEOWNERS additions for infra/*, updated .gitignore, and docs/policies/ci-dependency-policy.md documenting the rego rules and upgrade workflow. Migration notes: existing repos should switch to the templates by referencing the two files; a short migration script (scripts/migrate-to-templates.sh) is included to automate basic replacement. Tests and CI: Several CI runs initially failed due to the policy gate rejecting an unlicensed transitive dependency from a vendor package; I adjusted the rule to allow curated exceptions via policies/allowlist.json with comments pointing to the responsible team. All tests and e2e smoke checks passed on the final run. Related work: ENG-845 (CI consolidation), ENG-1290 (dependency policy).
commits: initial: add workflow templates and opa action
fix: allowlist exceptions for vendor transitive deps
docs: add dependency policy docs and migration script
ci: update redwood workflow to consume ci-template
review_comments: Samir Kohli: This is a useful consolidation — can we ensure the opa composite action runs in an ephemeral container and doesn't leak credentials? Please add a note to the action README explaining inputs/outputs and required secrets.
Asha Patel: Added entrypoint.sh to run OPA eval in a minimal alpine container and documented required secrets (GITHUB_TOKEN only). Updated action README in this PR.
Maya Liu: The matrix change is good but a repo like redwood-model-registry still needs Node 14 for a legacy tool. Can we add an opt-in flag to the template so subsystems can opt into legacy runtimes?
Asha Patel: Added 'legacy-runtimes' template input and adjusted migration script to preserve explicit legacy matrix entries when present.
Jared Thompson: I saw a transient CI failure where the canary job hit a rate limit on staging; recommend retry/backoff logic in the smoke-run step.
Asha Patel: Added retry with exponential backoff and a 3-attempt limit for the post-merge canary step.
ci_checks_summary: Checks: lint (pass), unit-tests (pass), opa-policy-check (pass after allowlist update), e2e-smoke (pass), release-canary (pass). Several reruns during review; final status green.
release_notes: Introduce reusable CI workflow templates and an OPA-based dependency policy gate. Standardize test matrices (drop legacy Node 12/14 by default), add post-merge canary release job, and provide migration script and docs. Impact: improved CI consistency and automated policy enforcement for dependency updates.
notes_for_operators: When rolling out to other repos: 1) run scripts/migrate-to-templates.sh in a branch, 2) review policies/allowlist.json for repo-specific exceptions, 3) add infra owners to CODEOWNERS to handle policy exceptions. For incidents where OPA blocks an urgent security bump, toggle the policy by creating a small PR to policies/allowlist.json and reference ENG-1290.
qa_summary: Manual QA: ran migration script on redwood-examples and redwood-model-registry, executed template-driven CI in a feature branch, exercised post-merge canary against staging with model routing toggled. Automated: unit and integration tests included in template. No regressions observed.
